name: @guardbee/mcp-dependency-auditor
description: MCP server that audits npm, pip, and cargo dependencies for known CVEs using the OSV database
long_description: Parses package.json/package-lock.json and requirements.txt/pyproject.toml manifests, queries the OSV vulnerability database in batch, and reports known CVEs with severity and fixed-version guidance. No API key required — runs entirely against public OSV data.
